fields.name: Text_Screen_New_Machine
fields.fieldText:
➕ Add Missing Machine

Use this screen only if the machine you need to check is not available in the existing machine selection.


🏷️ Add Customer-Managed Machine

Enter the required machine information to add it to the Quality Check.


ℹ️ This is typically used for machines that are owned or managed directly by the customer and are therefore not already available in Salesforce.


✅ Once the machine has been added, you can continue with the Quality Check.

fields.name: Text_Capture_Beverage_Results
fields.fieldText:
Capture Beverage Results for the selected machine


☕ Please select the beverage and product that should be tested for this machine.


For each beverage, enter a taste rating, an visual rating, and any relevant comments or recommendations.


You can use Add to capture multiple beverages for the selected machine.

fields.name: Text_Machine_Check_Summary
fields.fieldText:
Machine Check Summary


🛠️ Please complete the machine-related information before finishing this machine check.


Indicate whether a technician is required, whether machine settings need to be adjusted, and add any final machine-related comments.

fields.name: Text_Contact_on_site
fields.fieldText:
Optionally enter the contact person met on site, for example a bartender, service employee, or other local contact.

💡 Note: This person is only documented for the Quality Check and is not the responsible Contact of the Account.

fields.name: Text_Select_Machine
fields.fieldText:
Select Machine for Quality Check


🛠️ Please select the machine you would like to check.


If the machine is not listed, choose “Add new machine” to create a new machine record before continuing with the check.


Selected Machine:

fields.name: Text_Select_Contact
fields.fieldText:
👤 Select or create a contact


Select the contact associated with this Quality Check from the list below.


➕ If the contact is not available in the list, select None and click Next to create a new contact.


✅ Once you have selected the correct contact, click Next to continue.
